entry_points.summary: Top-level CLI entry: dispatches to cmd_inspect, cmd_wizard, cmd_apply, cmd_explain, or cmd_status based on subcommand arg
Inspect subcommand: delegates to --json, --flat, or grouped view; reads all config surfaces read-only
Machine-parseable JSON output of all resolved config keys with source, strength, and persistence_class
Flat key=value view with source column (git-config style); --flat flag
Default concern-grouped inspect view; groups keys by section; 8 sections including axioms
Wizard subcommand: runs concern-grouped guided flow; --scope limits to single section; emits wizard_section_start/end events
Apply subcommand: one-shot posture-preset bootstrap; computes diff, confirms, writes atomically via tomlkit; emits setup_apply_done
Explain subcommand: pass-through to scripts/config.py explain <key>
Status subcommand: compact one-line summary of configured layers, posture detected, providers bound, docs initialized, routing-preference count
Core read helper: calls config.py inspect-all, parses JSON output; used by inspect, wizard, apply, and status
Hardcoded dict of posture name -> {toml_keys: {key: value}, env_vars: {VAR: value}}; three presets: interactive, overnight, ci-batch
Computes diff between posture target and current effective config; returns dict of keys that need changes
Axioms wizard section: configure axioms TOML keys, install kernel-pointer in ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, add gitignore entries
Idempotently install canonical kernel-pointer marker block into CLAUDE.md; shows diff on mismatch; collapses duplicate blocks
Idempotently add an entry to .gitignore; returns added|already_present|error:<msg>
Heuristically identifies which posture (if any) the current config matches; used by cmd_status
Thin bash wrapper: exec python3 setup.py $@
Skill surface: parses invocation args, shells out to setup.py, renders output; uses AskUserQuestion for wizard prompts

invariants: setup.py apply is atomic: full TOML write via tomlkit + tmp+rename, or no write at all
setup.py inspect and _inspect_all_json are READ-ONLY: no file writes of any kind
Memories are never written by setup.py; edits route to /z-suggest-memory
The wizard always shows current effective state before any prompt — no blind first-run overwrite without consent
Posture presets are hardcoded constants in POSTURE_PRESETS; adding a new posture requires a code change
/z-setup skill shells out to setup.py; never reimplements config logic inline
Env-only knobs (NO_ASK, OVERNIGHT_AUTODECIDE, OVERNIGHT_AUTODECIDE_EFFECTIVE, PAUSE_AT_PCT, etc.) are surfaced read-only in inspect; configured via shell snippet, never written to TOML
Re-run is idempotent: diff-and-confirm always shown; silent overwrite is forbidden
setup.py apply --dry-run exits 0 after printing diff, with no writes
Wizard --scope values are canonicalized to lowercase (e.g. 'notifications', 'workflow', 'overnight', 'axioms') to match _SCOPE_SECTIONS keys; passing a capitalized name fails with exit 2
_install_kernel_pointer is idempotent: no-op when block already matches canonical; user-confirmed overwrite when block differs; collapses multiple marker blocks to one
gotchas: _inspect_all_json delegates to config.py inspect-all via subprocess; if config.py is unavailable or inspect-all is not registered, it returns None and all subcommands fail gracefully
Wizard sections for providers and docs are suggest-only: they detect gaps and print a tip to run /z-providers-discover or /z-init-docs but do NOT shell out to those commands
Memories section in the wizard is read-only display only; the tip instructs use of /z-suggest-memory --kind routing-preference
POSTURE_PRESETS env_vars are emitted as a shell snippet to stdout (or --env-file); they are not written to any config file
setup.py apply --yes skips the confirm prompt; use only in automation where user consent is established upstream
The overnight posture snippet sets Z_HARNESS_NO_ASK=halt; this activates overnight mode globally for the shell session and is mutually exclusive with Z_HARNESS_ASK_ALL=1
cmd_explain is a pure pass-through to config.py explain; it does not add new logic
_detect_posture is heuristic: if the current config partially matches a posture it returns 'custom' (not the preset name); it is not authoritative
_wizard_axioms kernel-pointer install targets ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md (global user file); it does NOT update per-repo CLAUDE.md files

The axioms wizard scope adds four env-only knobs (Z_HARNESS_AXIOMS_ENABLED, Z_HARNESS_AXIOMS_KERNEL_BUDGET_CHARS, Z_HARNESS_AXIOMS_EXTRACT_MIN_RECURRENCE, Z_HARNESS_AXIOMS_AUTO_EXTRACT_POST_RUN) that are NOT in the core ENV_ONLY_KNOBS list in config.py — they appear only in _SCOPE_ENV_KNOBS['axioms']
Wizard now has 8 scopes, not 7: notifications, workflow, overnight, providers, personas, docs, memories, axioms

event_vocabulary.description: Emitted at the start of every setup.py invocation before subcommand dispatch
Emitted after a successful apply write; includes posture name, number of TOML keys changed, number of env vars in snippet, and scope (global|repo)
Emitted at the start of each wizard section (notifications, workflow, overnight, providers, personas, docs, memories, axioms, final_review)
Emitted at the end of each wizard section after prompts and optional writes
Emitted after the wizard final-review section writes accumulated changes
Emitted by the /z-setup skill at invocation start, before any subprocess
Emitted by the /z-setup skill after all invocation-form logic including error paths
